Stage raster images and instance updates until immediately before successful frame submission. A later frame invalidates abandoned unsubmitted preparations. Warm glyphs avoid raster/upload; unchanged instances avoid buffer upload and retain allocation identity. CPU instance comparison snapshots bypass retention above256KiB.

Texture and instance allocations have stable IDs, owner/generation, API capacity and live/retiring records. Submission callbacks retain the same allocation until GPU completion. Observation may outlive renderer close without retaining resource handles.
